channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tony Romo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tony Romo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danny Green on Tony Romo
item.description:
“He’s still looking like we could sign him. He could come back for Game 6 in the Finals or something like that and collect a ring, if we make it. If we are up in Game 6, three (games) to two, sign him to a Romo deal.”

Danny Green on Tony Romo, Apr 17, 2017. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Michael Malone on Tony Romo
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Nuggets coach Michael Malone on Tony Romo:

“To me, it’s a little bit of a circus, so we’re not really worried about Tony Romo.”

Michael Malone on Tony Romo, Apr 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tony Romo
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on Tony Romo's shootaround performance:

“He just busted the ass of a few of our young guys out there, so that was fun.”

Rick Carlisle on Tony Romo, Apr 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Caron Butler on Tony Romo
item.description:
But one former Maverick knows Romo's basketball abilities better than most.

“Believe it or not, man, when we were in the prime of our careers, I used to always talk about it: [Romo] could have easily been a professional basketball player,”

Caron Butler on Tony Romo, Apr 10, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tony Romo
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Tony Romo:

“He won't be playing. He will be introduced as part of our intros.. . He will not be playing.”

Rick Carlisle on Tony Romo, Apr 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tony Romo
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Tony Romo:

“We want to pay a respectful tribute to himand I know our fans will look forward to it as well.”

Rick Carlisle on Tony Romo, Apr 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.
